NIA seeks approval to travel to UAE for flydubai probe statement

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) is seeking approval from the central government to travel to the United Arab Emirates (UAE). The purpose of the visit is to record a statement from Captain Smit Machchhar in connection with the probe into a flydubai hijack attempt. The NIA plans to obtain the Centre's nod for this international travel.
